scope: Indexed vertex output, stable label/smoothing grouping, final channel pipeline and borrowed result publication.

validation.case_scope: Four original-upper/shared concrete remap/append/growth/atan2 cases: expanded 2D channels/unweighted normals, indexed channels/angle-weighted normals, normal generation disabled, empty batch. Full72/RAM/CSR/events/ownership plus independent emitted indices/channel values, normalized normals, batch counts and complete teardown. External LO_MESH_MATH_CONSTANTS. Earlier four cases cover batch emission only. Three original grouping-upper/shared concrete sort/emission cases: one equal-key group, reverse face labels, equal labels with reverse smoothing masks. Full state/RAM/events/ownership and independent sorted face IDs/batch keys/counts plus teardown. Four final-pipeline original-upper/shared-concrete-lower cases: one label with normals/incidence, reverse labels, indexed channels with normals disabled, empty input rejection; full state/RAM/events/ownership plus independent published counts, label summaries, face permutation and teardown. Not gameplay validation. One indexed-input adapter original-upper/shared-concrete full pipeline case merges a duplicate tetrahedron point, copies retained geometry back, and frees all temporary ownership.
validation.platform: Linux x64 Clang19; pinned PPC; mmap guest overlay
